tasks.title: Build dashboard admin aggregates endpoint
tasks.description: Sprint 1 Tier S multiplier #3. The current admin dashboard fetches raw rows and aggregates client-side, causing -80% bytes / -80-90% CPU waste. Build app/api/admin/dashboard/aggregates/route.ts that returns pre-aggregated KPIs (today sales, week revenue, active carts, low stock count) using SQL GROUP BY + the cache helper.
tasks.review_notes: ROUND 1 (FAIL): acceptance criterion #6 not met — test file missing. ROUND 2 (PASS): Beta added __tests__/analytics-db-dashboard.test.ts with the 5 required tenant-isolation cases. Gamma round 2 verified all 5 cases are real (not dummy), tests match project conventions (compared with api-product-analytics.test.ts), and the next/cache mock is correctly added for 'use cache' directive. vitest 5/5 green in 1.30s, tsc clean. Non-blocking carryovers: (a) error-path zero-fallback caching in analytics.db.ts lines 159-173 may cache transient failures for up to 300s — defer to a follow-up observability task; (b) app/admin/page.tsx wiring transferred to TASK-003.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint returns today_sales, week_revenue, active_carts, low_stock_count in one call
Uses 'use cache' directive with cacheLife({ revalidate: 60, stale: 30, expire: 300 })
cacheTag tenant:${tenantId}:dashboard for surgical invalidation
requireAdmin(req, ['admin','cajero']) gate present
Payload size < 2 KB on p95 tenant
Unit test covers 5 tenant isolation cases

tasks.title: Create LoyaltyTransaction model + migration + backfill
tasks.description: TD-030 — app/api/marketplace/loyalty/route.ts references a LoyaltyTransaction model that does not exist in schema. Points history is lost; only the running balance is stored in Customer.loyaltyPoints. Create the model, migration, backfill synthetic transactions from current balances, and rewire the route.
acceptance_criteria: LoyaltyTransaction model has id, customerId, tenantId, amount, reason, createdAt, metadata JSON
Migration runs with DATABASE_URL=$DIRECT_URL npx prisma migrate deploy
Backfill script creates one synthetic transaction per customer with current loyaltyPoints
GET /api/marketplace/loyalty returns real history, not empty array
POST writes a transaction then updates the balance in a single Prisma transaction
New ADR 020 documents the decision
Unit test covers earn, redeem, and tenant isolation

claim_protocol.description: Agent reads orchestrator.json, picks a task with status=pending and agent in allowed_agents, writes status=in_progress + assigned_agent + started_at, saves the file. If two agents race, the second agent's diff fails and it picks another task.

review_protocol.description: When beta marks a task as status=review, gamma picks it up, runs verification_commands, and either flips to done (with reviewed_by=gamma + completed_at) or back to in_progress with a review_notes field.
